A full card image with the corrected text and a white E in the lower border, from the Players Committee's Holotable image set (8 July 2018).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-commandervandenwillard-PC-Errata-2018-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Commander Vanden Willard (PC Errata 2018 disc card)]] (by 25 January 2018): Same game text. The bronze disc is gone and a white italic “E” is printed in the black lower border; the text box is set again (348 × 488 pixels).

The whole 2018 disc card image and the whole 2018 E card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
